Title: Azure SQL Data Warehouse now offers transparent Data Encryption with customer managed keys

Body.Content: Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) with Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) support is generally available for Azure SQL Data Warehouse. This helps customers looking to protect sensitive data and meet regulatory or compliance obligations that require implementation of specific key management controls.
